title: Aggregated Operability Hub: Private Deployment Tile Deck & Troubleshooting Flow
creator: Amaya Chen
description: Design and prototype a single-pane "Aggregated Operability Hub" for private/VPC deployments that surfaces a tiled, actionable summary for cluster health, network topology anomalies, upgrade status, active rollouts, and tenant-level cost exposure. The hub is intended for SREs and platform engineers who need to triage cross-cluster incidents quickly and make safe rollout decisions; it must work for air-gapped/private setups where telemetry is delayed and for multi-region clusters. This ticket covers the desktop-first tile deck, inline drilldowns, compact quick-actions (canary pause/rollback, throttle) and a troubleshooting mode that walks engineers through common remediation steps while linking to runbooks and incident playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Tile deck shows at-a-glance status for Network, Cluster Health, Upgrade Queue, Active Rollouts, and Cost Exposure with sensible defaults; 2) Each tile supports 1-click action (Open Details / Pause Rollout / Start Diagnostics) with confirmation flows; 3) Drilldown pages include historical sparkline, top-3 contributing logs/alerts, and links to runbook + GitHub PR if present; 4) Prototype validated with 3 SREs and 2 platform PMs demonstrating reduced triage time in usability test; 5) Works in private deployments with mocked telemetry and indicates staleness; 6) Accessibility: all interactive controls keyboard-focusable and labeled; 7) Performance: initial render under 300ms with lazy-load detail panels
attachments: Confluence: operability-hub-spec (links to runbooks and test-plan)

design_notes: Key decisions: 1) Single-pane tile deck prioritized over multi-tab layout to reduce context shift during incidents; 2) Tiles are read-first with inline secondary actions to avoid accidental rollouts; 3) Troubleshoot mode is a guided, reversible flow that logs actions to the incident record; 4) Cost exposure card shows 7d delta with quick 'estimate-savings' simulator (non-authoritative) to help rollback decisions; 5) For private deployments, telemetry staleness is surfaced and default actions are conservative (recommend manual verification before automated rollback). Trade-offs: tighter data aggregation increases latency on first load; we rely on ENG endpoints to supply pre-aggregated summaries.
expected_outcome: Reduce mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) for private cluster incidents by surfacing correlated signals in one pane; enable safe, auditable rollout controls and provide a lower-friction path from alert to remediation.
notes_for_engineering: Engine work: provide /v1/operability-summary with fields: last_seen, status, top_alerts, recent_rollout, cost_delta, and staleness_flag. Support incremental detail endpoints for each tile to allow lazy loading. Rollout actions must be idempotent and return an operation id for audit logging (ENG-34021, ENG-34100).
